verdict.rationale: A tax agency's online services could plausibly offer a programmatic or headless interface for automated filing and payment, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes interactive Online Services accounts, Web File and Quick Pay; the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and robots.txt disallows the /e-services/ transaction paths. Filing through third-party approved software is someone else's capability, not this product's own headless or CI interface, so it earns no credit.
